name: Sound_Wave_LookupEntry
signature: int Sound_Wave_LookupEntry(SoundWaveTable* table, u32 waveId, u32* out)
summary: Resolves a wave ID through the inner wave table (calling Sound_Wave_GetDataAddress), and if found and an active extension resolver is attached at table+8, invokes its virtual slot +0x30 to fill or adjust the output entry descriptor. Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.
evidence: The base callee 0x00660B20 is now confidently named Sound_Wave_GetDataAddress (R_043), which populates the out buffer with the wave's sample data address and size. The direct caller 0x0054B004 is confidently named Sound_WaveCache_LoadRaw (R_023), which passes cache[1] and out to look up the wave entry size before invoking the heap allocator. Sibling 0x0065E340 is confirmed Sound_SeqParam_GetWaveRef (slot +0x2C), matching the dual base/extension resolver architecture.
